Council Meetings and Agendas

Livingstone Shire Council holds different types of meetings including Ordinary, Special and Budget Council meetings.

Ordinary Council Meetings are held in the Council Chambers at 4 Lagoon Place, Yeppoon on the first and third Tuesday of each month from 9am.

Members of the public are encouraged to watch our live stream of Ordinary Council Meetings and Committee Meetings via our YouTube Channel.

Minutes of these meetings are documented and are available for public viewing on this page. To access archived documents (pre-2018) please contact Customer Support on 1300 790 919.

As a Council we support the Constitutional Recognition of Australia's First People.
